text:
elaine: Quick sync — after last launch we have a backlog of ~14 customer bugs (sev2/3) and 6 enhancement asks from pilot accounts. Need to decide the next 2-week wave. Proposed: 60/40 bug:enhancement, reserve two engineers for hotfixes, one design slot for UX polish. Thoughts?

mike: +1 to reserves. Can we split bugs into regressions vs new? regressions = higher priority.

devon: UX impact: 2 enhancements move a key funnel metric, others are nice-to-have. We should protect design time for those 2.

lisa: CS input: pilot customer A is pushing hard for enhancement "Smart Snippets". They'll accept a workaround for ~2 weeks if we commit to a rollout ETA.

sahil: Infra note — one sev2 looks like streaming timeouts on Dedicated; I can run a quick postmortem early next week and scope the fix.

mike: Proposed eng allocation: eng1+eng2 -> bug stack (hotfixes/regressions), eng3 -> prototype Smart Snippets, eng4 -> infra + postmortem. Can start today.

elaine: Two immediate decisions: 1) canary vs full ship for Smart Snippets? 2) do we give pilot A an SLA workaround commitment?

mike: Canary only. Start with 10-20% traffic. We'll attach metrics and automatic rollback if error rate or latency regresses.

lisa: I'll tell pilot A we'll do a canary and give an ETA of 10 business days for full rollout if metrics look good. That keeps them happy.

devon: I'll prepare canary UX copy + fallback/error states. Also add a telemetry flag for when users hit the workaround.

elaine: Action items & rough due times: - mike: set up canary deployment + dashboard (due 1762345700) - devon: UX copy and fallback flows (due 1762345680) - sahil: infra postmortem + mitigation plan (due 1762345690) - engs: start bug fixes (start today). Reconvene Fri 09:30 PT to decide full rollout.

release-bot: deploy scheduled to canary at 1762345710 by mike.

mike: Working on a patch for the streaming timeout: PR created -> `fix/stream-timeout-guard`, running unit tests.

elaine: Nice. If anything blocks, @mike ping me immediately. :thumbsup:
